post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees.
post.judgeRationale: The PR adds code to split errors into "normal" and "instant" categories, track them separately in context, display them in separate tabs in the error overlay, and update the indicator pill styling to show amber for insights-only scenarios, which directly implements the Errors/Insights tab split feature claimed in the title.
